newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares close higher on earnings hopes.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares close higher on earnings hopes.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index closed higher on Thursday on buying in shares of firms expected to report robust 1996 earnings, brokers said.
The index rose 2.10 points or 1.45 percent to end at 147.59 on volume of 31.34 million shares worth HK$168 million against Tuesday's HK$279 million.
There was no trading in Shenzhen's A and B share markets on Wednesday due to the New Year's Day holiday.
On Thursday, investors were seen building positions in issues expected to release strong 1996 results, brokers said.
The Shenzhen bourse has announced that all Shenzhen-listed firms must make public their 1996 results by April 30.
"Most listed firms will have seen their results improved because of the two cuts in China's bank interest rates in 1996," one analyst said.
"But institutions were largely sidelined (on Thursday) due to a lack of major market-moving news," he added.
Television tube maker SEG was the biggest gainer, rising HK$0.34 or 5.82 percent to HK$6.18, on volume of 2.20 million shares on institutional buying, brokers said.
Guangdong Power rose HK$0.37 or 5.41 percent to HK$7.21 after 2.28 million shares were traded due to investor optimism over the power supplier's 1996 business results, brokers said.
Changan Automobile registered the day's heaviest trade of 2.86 million shares, climbing HK$0.08 to HK$4.69.
Chiwan Petroleum, the worst performing B share, slid HK$0.10 or 2.22 percent to HK$4.40.
The A share market staged a technical rebound on Thursday after a sharp decline in the previous session, brokers said.
The A index rallied 7.21 points or 2.11 percent to end at 349.02, on turnover of 5.80 billion yuan compared with 7.15 billion yuan on Tuesday.

Tellus Machinery surged 0.49 yuan to its limit-up of 5.36 yuan. Floppy disk maker Guangxia Yinchuan followed suit, ending at 7.55 yuan on trade of 6.76 million shares on speculative demand by institutions, brokers said.
